schemes.official_name: Multidisciplinary Design Program (MDP) - Industry Sponsored Projects
schemes.english_name: Multidisciplinary Design Program - Industry Sponsored Projects
schemes.module_code: ENGR 355/455 (UG, inferred not quoted); ENGR 555 (graduate, from Winter 2026)
schemes.description: Year-long (January-December, both semesters required) credit-bearing teams of about 5-7 students from across the university work on projects proposed by sponsoring organisations (companies, nonprofits, government), jointly mentored by a U-M faculty member and a sponsor member; teams hand over final work to the sponsor in the last week of classes and present at the Design Expo. The MDP page also describes 'internal University clients' among sponsors.
schemes.eligible_faculties_programmes: Undergraduate and master's students from all majors; Master of Engineering students cannot count MDP towards degree requirements; some projects restrict to US citizens/permanent residents (e.g. Fincantieri 26, Constellation-25)
schemes.eligibility_restrictions: No GPA requirement; all majors welcome; two-semester commitment; Ann Arbor campus; project-specific citizenship limits; application each autumn (mid-October deadline).
schemes.credit_assessment: Undergraduates 7-8 credits over two semesters; graduate students 4 credits total (ENGR 555 from Winter 2026); grading 40% individual / 60% team.
schemes.delivery_format: In-person multidisciplinary teams with faculty and sponsor mentors
schemes.project_evidence: Real-world sponsored projects with final work handed to sponsor and presented at Design Expo [1][2].
schemes.group_evidence: Small teams of 5-7 students; 60% of grade is team grade [2].
schemes.employer_evidence: Sponsor proposes the project, a sponsor member co-mentors the team weekly, and teams hand over final work to the sponsor [2][3]. Sponsor pages (Walbridge 26, UM Health 26, Fincantieri 26, Constellation-25) show company clients. Caveat: MDP counts 'internal University clients' among its 30-40 sponsors per year; UM Health is a university-affiliated body.
schemes.partner_role: Proposes project, co-mentors weekly, receives final handover
schemes.named_partners: Walbridge (2024-2026), Constellation (2025), Fincantieri (2026), UM Health (2026, internal/affiliated), Subaru, Qualcomm, JPMorgan Chase (tagged '27') - sponsor team pages
schemes.deliverable: Design/engineering project output handed over and presented to sponsor; Design Expo
schemes.unresolved: Share of internal vs external clients not published; whether every sponsored project has an external organisation (stated sponsors include internal University clients), so external coverage marked 'Some projects' but sponsored-project track is described as company/nonprofit/government clients. Course numbers not quoted from page. Sponsor-teams listing scope means C is Yes for named industry projects but coverage not quantified. Direct page fetch of mdp.engin.umich.edu returned 403 (Cloudflare 'Just a moment' challenge; not bypassed), so evidence is from search-index extracts.

sources.title: Start Here!
sources.extract: Projects run January to December, recruitment each fall with mid-October deadline; undergraduates earn 7-8 credits split across two semesters, graduate students 4 credits (search extract).

sources.title: About MDP
sources.extract: Small teams of 5-7 students guided weekly by faculty and sponsor mentors; jointly mentored by a U-M faculty member and a member of the sponsoring organization; teams present and hand over final work to sponsors in the last week of classes; 30-40 corporations, nonprofits, government entities and internal University clients each year; 40% individual / 60% team grades (search summary of MDP pages).

sources.title: Walbridge 26
sources.extract: Open to all students (F-1 students must declare part-time CPT); lists course substitutions such as ChE Elective and CS Capstone.

sources.title: Earn Academic Credit
sources.extract: From Winter 2026 graduate students earn credit under ENGR 555 (replacing ENGR 599); Master of Engineering students cannot count MDP toward degree requirements.

schemes.official_name: Multidisciplinary Action Projects (MAP) - Ross School of Business
schemes.module_code: BA 453 Capstone MAP (W26); MAP for MBA programmes
schemes.description: Team-based consulting field study in which sponsoring organisations bring real business problems to student teams. MBA MAP: teams of 4-6 for seven weeks with sponsor liaisons, data, interviews and a minimum two weeks on site; teams write a report and present to faculty and company representatives. Capstone MAP (BBA/Master of Management): teams do original research and deliver strategic recommendations to company executives.
schemes.eligible_faculties_programmes: Ross full-time/Global/Online/Executive/Weekend MBA; Capstone MAP: BBA and Master of Management (prerequisite STRATEGY 390 or Ross Minor)
schemes.year_of_study: MBA first year (full-time MBA); BBA senior (Capstone)
schemes.eligibility_restrictions: Ross programmes only; Capstone MAP elective with prerequisite.
schemes.credit_assessment: Capstone MAP: 3-credit elective (BA 453). MBA MAP credit not captured.
schemes.duration: MBA MAP seven weeks; Capstone MAP one term (W26)
schemes.delivery_format: Team consulting with sponsor site visits
schemes.project_evidence: Real business problem; detailed report and recommendations presented to faculty and company [1][2].
schemes.group_evidence: Teams of four to six Ross MBAs [2]; Capstone MAP project teams [3].
schemes.employer_evidence: Sponsors supply two liaisons, executive sponsor, data, interviews, site access and cover expenses; students present to sponsor representatives [1][2].
schemes.partner_role: Client: sets problem, supplies data/liaisons, receives report and presentation
schemes.named_partners: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Southeast Michigan (2026 BBA Capstone listing); Amazon, Caterpillar, Ford, Uber named as general MAP sponsors (not specific to Capstone MAP)
schemes.deliverable: Written report and presentation of recommendations
schemes.duration_band: ~1 term/semester (MBA MAP 1-4 weeks block of seven weeks)
schemes.latest_evidenced_year: 2026 (W26 Capstone MAP; Ross 2026 news: 175 projects a year)
schemes.participation_data: 175 projects a year (Ross 2026 news, via search summary); 79 BBA + 17 MM students on 20 Capstone MAP projects in one undated term
schemes.unresolved: Whether MAP is compulsory for all MBA streams not directly quoted; Capstone MAP is elective.

sources.title: Multidisciplinary Action Projects - MAP
sources.extract: Teams of first-year MBA students analyse a real, complex business problem with a participating company; write a detailed report and present recommendations to faculty and company representatives.

sources.title: MAP brochure
sources.extract: Seven weeks, team of four to six MBAs; sponsors provide two project liaisons and an executive sponsor, supply data, arrange interviews, cover expenses, and arrange minimum two weeks on site.

sources.title: Capstone MAP
sources.extract: Capstone MAP (BA 453), 3-credit elective offered W26; prerequisites STRATEGY 390 or Ross Minor; teams work with companies, startups, nonprofits on original research and present to executives.
